name: Combobox
title: Combobox
summary: A search field joined to a dropdown list: type to filter a long list, or press the caret to see every option, in a 48px form size and a 64px homepage hero size.
whenToUse: Long lists people know by name: Bible languages, countries, stations.
48px (`.fm-combo`): inside forms, e.g. "Language" on a partner form.
Hero (`.fm-dir`): the homepage Bible directory search, one per page, where picking a row opens that Bible on dot.Bible.
Fewer than 10 fixed options: use Select. Picking several: use MultiSelect. Free-text site search: use SearchField.

props.name: variant
props.description: `form` is the 48px field for forms; `hero` is the 64px homepage directory search (one per page).

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Called with the picked option's value.

props.name: onSelectOption
props.description: Called with the picked option. Use it in the hero to navigate to the chosen item.

props.name: hint
props.description: Hint under the field (form variant). Replaced by `error`.

props.name: error
props.description: Error message (form variant). Sets `aria-invalid="true"` and links the message.

props.name: showAllLabel
props.description: Accessible name of the caret button.

props.name: searchLabel
props.description: Accessible name of the hero `<form role="search">`.

props.name: formatHead
props.description: Text of the list head and the polite match-count announcement.

props.name: emptyText
props.description: Content shown when nothing matches. Receives the typed text.

props.name: emptyAction
props.description: Extra content after the empty text in the hero, for example a "Browse every language ↗" link.

props.name: goLabel
props.description: Trailing text on hero rows. Hero rows leave the page when picked.

props.name: wrapperClassName
props.description: Class on the outer wrapper (`.field` or `.fm-dir`). `className` goes on the input.

variantNotes: 48px: base `.input`, 36px round caret button inside the right edge, list `.fm-menu` 6px below (max 264px, scrolls).

Hero: 64px pill (`--radius-pill`, `--gray-300` border, soft shadow), 56px on phones; 44px caret; results panel `.fm-dir-results` with `--radius-lg` corners and `--shadow-card-dark`, 8px below, max 380px.
Filtering: the head reads "All languages · 12", then "3 matches" / "1 match".
Selected (48px only): `aria-selected="true"`, semibold `--horizon-blue-dim` and a blue tick.
Empty: `.fm-menu-empty` "No language matches “xyz”." Hero: `.fm-dir-empty` with a link "Browse every language on dot.Bible ↗".

states.universal: See rules/states.md for the seven required states and their hooks.

rules: Caret ⌄ means the list opens here. Hero rows end in "Open ↗" because picking leaves for another page.
Match on both the native name and the English name, ignoring accents and case.
Show the native name first and larger; English under it in `--gray-600`.
Focus or typing opens the list; Enter picks the first match; Esc closes.
Keep the caret button from stealing focus (prevent mousedown default) so typing continues.
One hero combobox per page. Do not shrink the hero below 56px.
On the 48px version, show the current choice as the placeholder ("አማርኛ · Amharic") and clear the typed text on pick.

Mark native names with `lang` (e.g. `lang="am"`) where possible.
